P0128.description: Coolant temperature below thermostat regulating temperature
P0128.lr3_notes: Usually the thermostat is stuck open. Confirm with a live log: the coolant never reaches about 88°C.

P0171.lr3_notes: On the 4.4 V8, codes for both banks (P0171 + P0174) usually mean a vacuum leak: PCV/breather hoses, intake gaskets, brake booster hose. Check the MAF and fuel pressure next.

P0174.lr3_notes: See P0171. If both banks are lean, suspect a shared cause.

P0300.lr3_notes: Check the coils and plugs first. A vacuum leak or low fuel pressure can also cause random misfires.

P0301.lr3_notes: Swap the coil with another cylinder and see whether the misfire follows it.

P0562.lr3_notes: Battery or charging problem. The LR3 throws many unrelated faults when voltage is low.

P0700.lr3_notes: The TCM has stored its own code. Read the transmission module with a Land Rover-capable tool (e.g. GAP IIDTool).

P0730.lr3_notes: Check the fluid level and condition (ZF 6HP26).
